battle.name: 後周攻南唐之戰
battle.brief: 顯德二年十一月後周大舉南下攻南唐，淮南壽州紫金山一線成了主戰場。此役弓矢仍是壓制城頭與野戰的骨架，亞述長弓那類複合反曲弓正是反曲弓形制的早期代表，與當年後周騎兵步卒所拉的中原弓弩同屬弓兵體系，攻城器械與糧秣轉運則決定了淮南十四州的歸屬。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰一方是五代後周，另一方是割據江南的南唐，北方後漢餘脈北漢則因南唐的祕密往來被捲入糾紛。後周由世宗郭榮坐鎮大梁，樞密院掌軍令，殿前司與侍衛親軍司領禁軍，出征最高指揮為淮南行軍總管李重進，張永德、李從進分道策應，趙匡胤以殿前宿衛身份領禁軍精騎擔任鋒銳與追擊，戰線沿汴河、淮河推進，汴口、泗州、宿州一線徵調船戶與民夫轉輸糧秣戰具。南唐此時由中主李璟在金陵坐鎮，元帥府與諸道節度使分掌軍政，淮南方面分置濠州、壽州等節鎮：壽州由劉仁贊坐鎮，紫金山由劉建用屯兵，濠州守將趙匡明，各節鎮兵不相屬，調度遲緩。南唐水軍與市鎮兵眾多而精於舟楫，騎兵卻稀少，常務以步兵、水軍當主力，江北防線一旦被突破便再無險可守。
countriesEn: The war was fought between the Five Dynasties state of Later Zhou and the Jiangnan regime of Southern Tang, while the northern rump state of Northern Han was drawn in through Southern Tang's secret contacts with it. Later Zhou was directed by Emperor Shizong Guo Rong from the capital Daliang. The Bureau of Military Affairs issued the operational orders, the palace guard offices and the imperial guard armies supplied the central troops, and overall command of the southern campaign rested with Li Chongjin, appointed commander of the Huai River expedition, while Zhang Yongde and Li Congjin advanced on separate axes and Zhao Kuangyin, a senior officer of the palace guard command, led the fastest mounted detachment as spearhead and pursuit force. The line of advance ran along the Bian and Huai rivers, with boat crews and corvée labour requisitioned along the stretch from the Bian mouth through Suzhou and Haozhou to move grain and war materiel. Southern Tang, then ruled from Jinling by the middle emperor Li Jing, divided authority between the marshal's office and the regional military governors. On the Huai front it had set up such prefectures as Haozhou and Shouzhou: Shouzhou was held by Liu Renzan, Liu Jianyou garrisoned Mount Zijin, and Zhao Kuangming commanded Haozhou. These governors did not subordinate themselves to one another and could not concentrate their troops. Southern Tang had many soldiers skilled with boats and in water work, but few cavalrymen, so infantry and naval units formed the core of its army; once the northern line was pierced there was no natural barrier left to hold.
people: 後周世宗郭榮是此役的策劃者與最高指揮，他剛平定北漢與西南邊患，趁軍威正盛轉向江淮，屢次親至前線督戰，舊患足疾仍行軍不輟，意圖以速戰迫南唐就範。李重進原為南唐將領，歸後周後受任淮南行軍總管，是攻壽州的主將；張永德守禦正陽、拒南唐援軍有功，其後補殿前都點檢；李從進與趙匡胤各領一軍，趙匡胤所部騎兵是全軍機動最快的一支。南唐方面，中主李璟晚年多病而諸子爭儲，謀主宋齊丘、齊王李景達與掌軍者意見不一；守壽州的劉仁贊把城堅守到底，城破被擒後在闕下慷慨陳詞，世宗嘉其忠勇，釋之而不殺，是南唐唯一大將全身而退。南唐遣往大梁議和的使臣陳覺、孫晟，則在割地成議的最後關鍵時刻替南唐主簽下稱臣表章。
peopleEn: Emperor Shizong Guo Rong was the planner and supreme commander of the campaign. Having just settled Northern Han and the troubles on the southwestern frontier, he turned on Jianghuai while the army's prestige was at its height, rode to the front more than once to supervise the fighting, and pushed on despite an old infirmity of the feet, in the hope of forcing Southern Tang to terms quickly. Li Chongjin, formerly a Southern Tang general who had come over to Later Zhou, was appointed commander of the Huai River expedition and led the main effort against Shouzhou. Zhang Yongde earned credit for holding Zhengyang and beating off Southern Tang relief columns, and was later appointed commander of the palace guard. Li Congjin and Zhao Kuangyin each led a separate column, and the mounted troops under Zhao were the fastest-moving force in the whole army. On the Southern Tang side the middle emperor Li Jing was elderly and frequently ill, his sons squabbled over the succession, and the minister Song Qiqiu, the Prince of Qi Li Jingda and the military commanders could not agree. Liu Renzan, who held Shouzhou, defended the city to the end; captured when it fell, he spoke boldly before the throne, and Shizong admired his loyalty and released him instead of putting him to death, which made him the only Southern Tang general of rank to return home. The envoys Chen Jue and Sun Sheng, sent by Southern Tang to Daliang, finally signed the submission on behalf of their ruler at the very moment the cession was agreed.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓，是近東已知最早成規模使用的複合反曲弓形制之一，弓體短而張力強，可在馬背上拉弦，亞述人正是靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射箭開路、車兵隨其後而入。放回955年的淮南戰場，弓仍是遠程作戰的基本手段：後周與南唐的步卒持角木弓、竹木弓，騎兵用更小、更易控弦的弓，兩類弓在形制上都屬反曲弓這一大家族，亞述弓是其中的近東早期代表，中原弓則自周代以來自成一路，形制細節並不相同。真正決定壽州攻防的還有弩，臂弩與床弩以強弩矢破甲傷人；攻城一方備飛石、巢車、撞竿、雲梯與版築填壕之物，守方靠高壘、深壕、拒馬、鹿角與大盾抵擋。五代兵甲以札甲、皮甲為主，鎖子甲在中原並不普遍；南唐水軍多舟船並備竹木盾與皮甲，後周騎兵多自河北、山東徵馬，人馬皆重甲。除刀、槍、戟、陌刀等常備兵器外，唐末五代已見火藥箭與毒箭施於城頭，守城者還需備繩索、袋土以塞缺口。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card face is one of the earliest composite recurve bow forms known to have been used on a large scale in the Near East: short, powerful and capable of being drawn from the saddle, it was the combination of the bow and iron that carried the Assyrians through the two river lands, with archers shooting from the chariots to open the way and the chariot troops following behind. Set back into the Huai River battlefield of 955, the bow remained the basic instrument of long-range combat. Infantry of both Later Zhou and Southern Tang carried horn-and-wood or bamboo-and-wood bows, while mounted men used smaller and more easily controlled bows; both kinds belong to the great family of recurve bows, of which the Assyrian bow is the early Near Eastern representative, whereas the Central Plains bow had followed its own line since the Zhou dynasty and differs in the details of its form. What really decided the struggle over Shouzhou was the crossbow, arm bows and bed bows loosing heavy bolts that split armour and struck down men. The besiegers brought stone-throwers, siege towers, battering rams, ladders and earth-filled fascines for filling the ditch, while the defenders relied on tall stockades, deep ditches, caltrops, spiked barriers and large shields. Armour of the Five Dynasties consisted mainly of lamellar and leather protection, brigandine being uncommon in the Central Plains. Southern Tang's flotilla used boats with bamboo-and-wood shields and leather armour, while Later Zhou's cavalry drew most of its mounts from Hebei and Shandong and rode and fought in heavy protection. Beside the usual knives, spears, halberds and the Tang-style long sabres, the gunpowder arrow and the poisoned arrow already seen in the late Tang and the Five Dynasties were used against defenders on the walls, and the garrison also needed rope and bags of earth to plug breaches.
tactics: 後周的戰術是典型的騎兵機動加攻城器械配合。前段以精騎掃清淮南各處零散據點與江北巡邏隊，阻斷南唐水軍在淮河上的接應；中段分兵攻取濠州、滁州等沿淮州縣，並在淝河、淮水之間架浮橋、造舟船，解決大軍與糧秣過河的問題。李重進攻紫金山時因山勢險峻、南唐據高而一度失利，遂轉為強攻壽州，改採穩紮慢打。壽州據淮水南岸，地形堅險，後周不敢驟攻，乃四面分築營壘合圍，隔絕其陸路糧道，同時以弩矢、穿甲箭與飛石覆蓋城頭，逼近後再以巢車、撞竿攻其門樓；南唐屢遣援軍溯淮而來，後周以騎兵在援軍渡岸未穩、陣形未整之際反覆邀擊，屢破之，使孤城無援可恃。圍城日久，南唐援兵、糧草、器械俱乏，軍心先於城垣崩解，後周則靠汴泗方向的漕運與徵發船戶民夫維持糧薪箭石，終以近一年的圍困耗盡守軍。攻守雙方都用弓弩覆蓋對方的視界，後周以弩陣壓制城頭的射孔，南唐則以弓手與舟師自城上反擊，屢有騎兵逼近城下時中矢而退者；圍城後期，後周另遣一軍扼守要道，專截南唐的糧船與援兵，使壽州一城在糧道盡斷之後只剩坐食待盡。
tacticsEn: Later Zhou's method was the classic combination of mounted manoeuvre and siege engineering. In the opening phase the light cavalry swept out scattered strongholds and river patrols across the Huai, cutting off Southern Tang's naval reinforcement on that river. In the middle phase the army split to take Haozhou, Chuzhou and other prefectures along the river, then bridged the Fei River and the Huai with pontoon bridges and boats so that troops and grain could cross. Li Chongjin's assault on Mount Zijin failed when the ground was steep and Southern Tang held the heights, and he turned instead to a direct attack on Shouzhou, adopting a slow, steady method. Shouzhou stands on the south bank of the Huai in strong ground, so Later Zhou did not strike rashly but built separate camps on several sides to close it in and sever its landward supply route, while covering the walls with crossbow bolts, armour-piercing arrows and stone missiles, and only then bringing up siege towers and rams against the gates and gate towers. Southern Tang repeatedly sent relief columns up the Huai, and Later Zhou's cavalry ambushed them again and again at the moment of landing, before the formations had closed, so that the isolated city gained no help. As the siege dragged on, the relief troops, grain and equipment of the defenders ran short and morale broke before the walls did. Later Zhou sustained grain, fuel and arrows by the transport of the Bian and Si waterways and by pressing boat crews and labour into service, and so wore the garrison down over the better part of a year.
data: 時間上，後周自顯德二年十一月出兵，至顯德四年南唐割地議和，前後約兩年八個月；壽州之圍自顯德三年春開打到顯德四年正月前後，歷時約一年，通鑑記世宗三赴前線，足見攻堅之難。割讓範圍為長江以北的淮南十四州，據通鑑所記，南唐除割地外還需歲貢絲二十萬匹、銀十萬兩，並奉後周年號、去帝號改稱國主，後周則稱之為江南國主。兵力數字史無明確記載，通鑑僅稱大舉出征，後周集中禁軍精銳數萬，南唐壽州一城守軍則諸說並存，或稱數千、或稱萬餘，而攻城與守城的實際消耗遠大於常規戰役。地理上，壽州至大梁約七百餘里，紫金山在壽州城北，淮河在此段寬達數里，舟楫是渡河與運糧的關鍵。淮南十四州既入，後周隨即以中樞直接控制江淮防務，江北的城防、屯田與漕運樞紐一併轉入中原朝廷的編制，成為日後北宋進取江南的現成基地。
dataEn: In time, Later Zhou set out in the eleventh month of XianDe year two and the war was settled by the cession in XianDe year four, a span of roughly two years and eight months. The siege of Shouzhou, begun in the spring of XianDe year three, ran until around the first month of XianDe year four, close to a year, and the chronicle records that the emperor travelled to the front three times, which shows how hard the reduction proved. The territory ceded was the fourteen prefectures of Huai north of the Yangtze. According to the Comprehensive Mirror, apart from the land Southern Tang was also to pay an annual tribute of 200,000 bolts of silk and 100,000 taels of silver, to use the Later Zhou reign title, to drop the imperial title and become a ruler, with Later Zhou calling him the Prince of Jiangnan. Exact troop numbers are not recorded: the chronicle speaks only of a great expedition, Later Zhou committing tens of thousands of picked imperial troops, while the Southern Tang garrison at Shouzhou is variously given as several thousand or as more than ten thousand; the consumption of men and material in a siege of this kind far exceeded that of an ordinary battle. In geography, Shouzhou lay some seven hundred odd li from Daliang, Mount Zijin lay north of the city, and the Huai was several li wide at this stretch, so boats were the key to crossing the river and to moving grain.
cause: 此役爆發的直接導火線是南唐與北漢的祕密來往。南唐自視為江南小帝，雖年年奉後周年號、進奉歲貢，卻仍以帝號自居，與後周維持表面臣屬而實行自治的關係；955年南唐遣使祕通北漢，事為邊將所覺，後周遂以此為口實出兵。深層原因則是後周的統一布局：北漢已平，西南無大患，南唐卻扼江淮之衝、屏障江南，與後周形成南北對峙，誰先取淮南誰就取得進取江南的地形。開國不久的後周以禁軍精銳立國，兵制經整頓而強，反觀南唐連年對楚用兵、國力已衰，統帥暮惰、諸鎮割據，處處分兵守城而無集中兵力作戰的能力。雙方實力與意圖此消彼長，戰爭遂以南唐拒絕輸誠、後周必欲取淮南而全面爆發。
causeEn: The immediate spark was Southern Tang's secret contacts with Northern Han. Southern Tang regarded itself as a small imperial house in the south: although it used the Later Zhou reign title and sent annual tribute year after year, it still assumed the imperial title and governed autonomously, so its relationship with Later Zhou was one of surface vassalage. In 955 Southern Tang sent envoys to Northern Han in secret, the matter was discovered by the border authorities, and Later Zhou used it as the pretext for war. The deeper cause lay in the unification strategy of Later Zhou: with Northern Han pacified and no great trouble in the southwest, it was Southern Tang that blocked the Jianghuai and screened Jiangnan, leaving the two states in a north-south confrontation in which whoever first took the Huai would gain the ground from which to advance on Jiangnan. The recently founded Later Zhou rested on its picked imperial troops, which had been reorganised and were strong, whereas Southern Tang, after years of war against Chu, was exhausted, its commanders old and slack, its regional governors autonomous, its troops scattered to hold cities with no force concentrated for a single decision. As relative strength and intention shifted, the war broke out in full when Southern Tang refused to show sincere submission and Later Zhou was determined to take the Huai.
impact: 淮南十四州易主，是此役最沉重的後果。南唐自此退守江南，失去淮河這道天然屏障與運河北段的轉運樞紐，江北的田賦、丁口與漕運收入盡歸中原，國力自保大之世的鼎盛一落千丈，軍隊再無北進之力，防守也只剩下長江一線。中主李璟在割地同年三月病卒於金陵，諸子爭儲與國勢崩壞的憂憤，加上新主李煜性柔而無兵柄，南唐對中原的態度由對抗全面轉為恭順，成為宋的附庸式政權。對中原而言，後周拿到了南面屏障，統一南北的戰略格局成形，淮南十四州後來正是宋軍進攻江南的通道與基地。959年世宗崩、恭帝幼弱，960年趙匡胤於陳橋兵變建宋，宋承後周疆域與整軍成果，974年出兵、976年滅南唐，955年這場戰爭定下的淮南線，正是那條戰略通道的起點。
impactEn: The transfer of the fourteen Huai prefectures was the heaviest consequence of the war. Southern Tang fell back on Jiangnan, losing the Huai as a natural barrier and the northern section of the transport artery; the land tax, the population and the transport income north of the river went to the Central Plains, and the state fell away from the height of its prosperity, with no strength left to advance north and no defence beyond the Yangtze. The middle emperor Li Jing died of illness at Jinling in the third month of the very year in which the land was ceded; the friction among his sons over the succession, combined with the sense of a collapsing state, was followed by the accession of Li Yu, whose gentle nature left him without real military authority. Southern Tang's attitude towards the Central Plains changed from resistance to plain obedience, and the country became a vassal in all but name. For the Central Plains, gaining the southern screen settled the strategic pattern of unifying north and south, and those fourteen prefectures later became the corridor and base from which Song armies marched into Jiangnan. Shizong died in 959 and the child emperor was weak; in 960 Zhao Kuangyin seized power at Chenqiao and founded Song, inheriting Later Zhou's territory and its reformed army, and in 974 the Song marched out and in 976 they destroyed Southern Tang. The Huai line fixed in 955 was the starting point of that corridor.
result: 結果是南唐大敗求和，割長江以北十四州予後周，遣使稱臣，奉後周年號，去帝號改稱國主，後周稱其為江南國主，雙方以淮水為界劃定疆域，戰事至此平息。後周沒有渡江，也沒有滅南唐：其舟師與水戰能力不足以支撐強攻長江天塹，跨越千里水陸線亦超出當時後周的後勤上限，因此此役的目標止於取淮南、令南唐稱臣割地，以戰促和。南唐在壽州陷落後再無可恃之城與可用之兵，議和時已無從置喙。壽州守將劉仁贊城破被擒、押至大梁，世宗不予誅殺而釋之歸國，此舉既收撫人心，亦向江南傳達不必死戰的訊號。回頭看全役，弓弩仍是壓制城頭與野戰的骨架，攻城器械、騎兵機動與糧秣運輸的配合，才真正決定了淮南十四州的歸屬。回頭看全役的得失亦可明白：再好的弓手也難以僅憑矢石破開依山傍水的州城，必須靠騎兵切斷外援、靠器械逼近城門、靠長期圍困耗盡守軍，三者缺一不可。
resultEn: Southern Tang was defeated and sued for peace, ceding the fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze to Later Zhou, sending envoys to profess submission, using the Later Zhou reign title, dropping the imperial title and becoming a ruler, with Later Zhou styling him the Prince of Jiangnan; the two sides marked the border at the Huai and the fighting came to an end. Later Zhou neither crossed the river nor destroyed Southern Tang. Its fleet and its ability in river warfare were not strong enough to support a forced attack on the Yangtze barrier, and moving men and supplies across a thousand li of water and land exceeded the logistic reach of Later Zhou at that time, so the object of the campaign stopped at taking the Huai, forcing Southern Tang to submit and cede territory, and using war to bring about peace. After Shouzhou fell, Southern Tang had no dependable city left and no army worth the name, and had no voice in the terms when the talks opened. Liu Renzan, the defender of Shouzhou, was captured and taken to Daliang; the emperor set him free instead of executing him, an act that both won hearts and sent a message to the south that the war need not be fought to the death. Looking back over the whole campaign, bows and crossbows remained the skeleton that suppressed the walls and fought in the open field, while siege engines, mounted manoeuvre and the movement of supplies decided which side the fourteen prefectures of the Huai would end up on.
